description: The complete Romania income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Salary month by month: CAS 25%, CASS 10%, 10% tax, personal deduction by dependants and income, under-26 deduction, children in school; Tax-free 300 / 200 lei of the minimum wage (OUG 89/2025); pillar III and medical subscriptions up to 400 EUR each; Pensions: CASS and tax above 3,000 lei a month; PFA: sistem real or norma de venit, CAS bands 12/24 minimum wages, CASS 6 to 72 minimum wages; Rental income with the 20% (30% tourist) flat expenses, withheld or declared; Dividends 16%, interest 10%, shares 3%/6% (Romanian broker) or 16% (foreign broker, losses carried forward), crypto 16%, foreign tax credit; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in RON; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's income tax and contributions for Romania, tax year 2026 (calendar year), for a Romanian tax resident (worldwide income) or a non-resident (Romanian income only). Amounts in lei (RON) for the whole year unless stated; leave out what does not apply.

age.description: Age in 2026 (under 26: extra personal deduction). Default 35

eur_rate.description: Lei per euro for the 400 EUR limits. Default 5.09

foreign_salary.description: Salary from work abroad, for a resident (venituri din salarii din străinătate)

contributions_abroad.description: Compulsory social contributions paid abroad on it, lei for 2026

gross.description: Gross salary abroad, converted to lei, lei for 2026

method.description: credit (Romania taxes it at 10% minus the foreign tax, the usual treaty method) or exempt (the treaty exempts it). Default credit

tax_paid.description: Income tax paid abroad on it, lei for 2026

norma.description: Norma de venit for a full year, for your activity and county (also enter receipts to compare with sistem real), lei for 2026

opt_in_cas.description: Pay pension contribution (CAS) on 12 minimum wages although net income is below that. Default false

regime.description: none, real (sistem real: receipts − expenses) or norma (norma de venit). Default none

broker_foreign.description: Net gain on shares sold through a foreign broker (negative for a loss), lei

broker_ro_long.description: Gains on shares sold through a Romanian broker, held 365 days or more (3% withheld), lei for 2026

broker_ro_short.description: Gains through a Romanian broker, held less than 365 days (6% withheld), lei for 2026

crypto.description: Net crypto gain for the year (negative for a loss), lei

crypto_small_only.description: Every crypto gain was under 200 lei per transaction

dividends_ro.description: Gross dividends from Romanian companies (16% withheld), lei for 2026

foreign_dividend_tax.description: Tax withheld abroad on those dividends, lei for 2026

foreign_interest_tax.description: Tax withheld abroad on that interest, lei for 2026

interest_ro.description: Interest from Romanian banks (10% withheld), lei for 2026

losses_carried.description: Foreign-broker losses carried forward from earlier years, lei for 2026

other_for_cass.description: Other income that counts for the health contribution (already taxed), lei for 2026

paid.description: Paid already towards the annual return (Declarația unică, formular 212)

du_advance.description: Tax and contributions paid in advance, lei for 2026

paid_on.description: Date you pay the balance, YYYY-MM-DD; after 25 May 2027 late interest (0.02%/day) and penalty (0.01%/day) run. Default: on time

withheld_other.description: Tax withheld by payers on income you declare, lei for 2026

paid_by_company.description: The tenant is a company that withholds the tax

tourist.description: Short-term tourist rental of 1-7 rooms (30% flat expenses instead of 20%)

residency.description: Tax residence (rezidență fiscală): resident (home in Romania, centre of vital interests there, or 183+ days in 12 months) or nonresident. Default resident

bonus.description: Bonus, paid with the last month worked, lei for 2026

children_in_school.description: Children enrolled in school, claimed by you (100 lei a month each). Default 0

dependants.description: Persons in your care (persoane în întreținere), including children. Default 0

gross_annual.description: Gross salary for the months worked, without bonus, lei for 2026

health_insurance.description: Voluntary health insurance or medical subscription you pay (deductible up to 400 EUR), lei for 2026

main_job.description: This is your main job (funcția de bază), where the personal deduction is given. Default true

minimum_wage_contract.description: Full-time contract whose base salary equals the minimum wage: 300 / 200 lei a month tax-free. Default false

pillar3.description: Your own voluntary pension (pillar III) contributions (deductible up to 400 EUR), lei for 2026

treaty_rate_dividends.description: Non-residents only: withholding rate on Romanian dividends under a tax treaty (convenție de evitare a dublei impuneri), with a residence certificate, as a fraction, e.g. 0.05. Default 0.16

treaty_rate_interest.description: Non-residents only: treaty withholding rate on Romanian interest, as a fraction, e.g. 0.10. Default 0.16
